kind: V7 architecture design and feasibility prototype; not a released V7

validation.patch_reproduction: Applied to an independent V6 source copy; every resulting source file matches the R4 snapshot byte-for-byte

prototype.validation_scope: R2 has full commit-by-commit correctness. R3 only separates prospective Load payload control and passes official 19-case cycle comparison. R4 only replaces address addition with a formally equivalent carry-select adder. The final R4 passes official 19-case correctness, performance with and without trace, faults and 18 forward-progress probes; complete V7 timing-coverage, small/scalar configurations, writeback-fault and Linux simulator release regressions remain.

screening_limitations: Early structural prototypes were performance screens. Some were later found to need blocked-EX preservation, Load retry or latch-free selection; none is a release candidate. Do not add marginal gains or treat retirement-gap counts as additive CPI components.
